ValidationRule.description: Prevents Estimated Delivery Date from being set to a past date when status is not Delivered or Cancelled. Business Purpose: Ensures the estimated delivery date is always a future date for active shipments.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(OR( ISPICKVAL(Shipment_Status__c, 'Delivered'), ISPICKVAL(Shipment_Status__c, 'Cancelled') )), NOT(ISBLANK(Estimated_Delivery_Date__c)), Estimated_Delivery_Date__c < TODAY() )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Estimated Delivery Date cannot be set to a past date for active shipments.
